what_slowed_you_down: Installing @monid-ai/cli globally with default npm settings failed with EACCES on /usr/lib/node_modules, requiring a fallback install with --prefix ~/.local.

anyapi /tiktok.search_keyword rejected sortBy="date-posted" on its default route (giraffe) with a 400 source_unknown error even though "date-posted" is listed in the schema enum, requiring an inspection of the error and a retry without sortBy.

YouTube search endpoints (litescrape /youtube/search and anyapi /youtube.search) only return relative publish strings like "2d ago" instead of exact timestamps, requiring individual follow-up calls to tikhub /api/v1/youtube/web_v2/get_video_info for each video to get exact ISO publish dates.
